goal: Prevent node crashes from unhandled write exceptions when saving blocks to disk
Allow graceful fatal shutdowns and clear error logging instead of abrupt termination on full filesystems
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Concept approval because turning write failures into normal error handling is a clear improvement (ryanofsky)
Support after confirming the fix matches existing stream safety patterns (maflcko, sedited)
Support based on encountering the same write failure bug (w0xlt)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it fixes a crash regression where write errors during stream destruction invoke std::terminate
Ensures stream primitives cleanly unwind without throwing secondary exceptions in destructors

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it prevents abrupt node crashes during block and undo data writes when disks fill up
Allows block storage operations to cleanly handle disk errors and shut down safely
